adminCode: configured server-side; not stored in this file

browserAccess: Install advertisement with playable browser preview
features: Classic: vertical playfield, left/right movement, upward firing
Adventure: scrolling streets, omnidirectional movement, aim assist, dodge and melee
Six bosses, artwork weapons, cinematic entrances and mutations
Seven-second kill streak boosts: x2 / x4 / x10
Shared app profile and popup character gallery
Independent Classic and Adventure save slots and device records
Bundled original music, boss theme and entrance sting
Offline game assets and local Supabase client bundle
notes: Reconciled repository main d2c2d16, including menu and unified profile fixes.
Online leaderboard contains Classic runs only; Adventure has a separate device best.
Optional scoreboard OCR requires an internet connection.
